tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Confirmed by TechCrunch: a Theranos whistleblower warns that the artificial intelligence boom is a great opportunity to go deceive people, as a documentary on Holmes sparks investor caution.
Confirmed by The Guardian: Anthropic's 92-page risk factor document details artificial intelligence dangers included in their IPO filing.
Confirmed by The Next Web: Cognizant deploys 25,000 staff to OpenAI tools for clients, cutting content time by 60 percent.
Still open, per Game Developer: Anthropic appears to have ordered Claude to stop remaking video games, citing intellectual property concerns.
Reported by JD Supra: lawyers face ethical risks using artificial intelligence after sanctions for hallucinated legal citations in Mata v. Avianca.
Free every hour.
